label: Дверь
description: Twelve-mission case drill for дверь (door) — all six cases, singular and plural.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative singular. The dictionary form дверь is the subject here, the thing being described, so it stays in its bare -ь shape. As a third-declension feminine noun, дверь shows no ending in the nominative; the case work begins only in the oblique forms.

Strategic focus: Genitive singular. The negation of existence with нет demands the genitive, and дверь shifts to двери. A defining trait of the third declension is that genitive, dative, and prepositional singular all collapse into this single -и form, so двери here is identical to the dative and prepositional.

Strategic focus: Dative singular. The preposition к governs the dative, marking the door as the goal of motion, and the form becomes двери. In the third declension the dative shares its -и ending with both the genitive and the prepositional singular, so all three look alike; the instrumental alone breaks ranks with -ью.

Strategic focus: Accusative singular. The door is the direct object of закрой, so it takes the accusative. Because дверь is an inanimate third-declension noun, its accusative is identical to the nominative — the bare -ь form дверь, with no special object ending.

Strategic focus: Instrumental singular. The preposition с triggers the instrumental, and дверь takes its distinctive ending to become дверью. This -ью form is the one place where the third declension stands apart: while genitive, dative, and prepositional share -и, the instrumental singular alone is -ью.

Strategic focus: Prepositional singular. The locational на governs the prepositional, so дверь becomes двери. This -и ending is the third member of the singular trio — genitive, dative, and prepositional are all spelled двери — while only the instrumental дверью differs.

Strategic focus: Nominative plural. As the plural subject of the sentence, дверь moves to the nominative plural двери. The third-declension plural adds -и to mark the nominative, the same vowel that crowded the singular oblique forms but now signalling plurality.

Strategic focus: Genitive plural. The negation нет requires the genitive plural, and дверь takes the third-declension ending -ей to become дверей. This -ей is the regular genitive-plural marker for soft feminine nouns of this class, replacing the singular's -и.

Strategic focus: Dative plural. The preposition к governs the dative, and in the plural дверь takes the ending -ям, giving дверям. Unlike the singular, where dative coincided with genitive and prepositional, the plural cases are all clearly distinct.

Strategic focus: Accusative plural. The doors are the direct object of красят, so they take the accusative plural. Since дверь is inanimate, its accusative plural matches the nominative plural — двери — rather than the genitive.

Strategic focus: Instrumental plural. The instrumental marks the means of separation here, and дверь takes the plural ending -ями to become дверями. The singular's special -ью gives way in the plural to the ordinary -ями shared across the declensions.

Strategic focus: Prepositional plural. The preposition о, marking the topic of conversation, governs the prepositional, and дверь becomes дверях with the plural ending -ях. The singular merger of genitive, dative, and prepositional into -и does not apply in the plural, where each case has its own form.
